variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. The occurrence is established, while a particular injury or legal finding is not supplied here. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of safety responsibility from an invented account of the accident's cause or the condition of those involved.

Going to work should not make a person's safety an afterthought. Labour has every reason to insist on that principle. We should also distinguish an accident from an unreported finding about its cause, because solidarity requires a truthful account as well as a firm demand for decent conditions.

We criticise {target} on the standard of safety stewardship. An accident warrants serious questions about responsibility, rather than a comfortable presumption that the conduct surrounding work should remain beyond public judgment. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.sub: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident.
